ios.desc:
No more being handed workouts without accountability. 

Firefly delivers personalized daily home workouts guided by an AI fitness coach that corrects your form in real time. Using your phone’s camera, Firefly builds real workout habits through verbal and visual cues tailored to your mobility level.

We can’t see your video and we never save it, keeping your workouts 100% private for you.

With Firefly, you'll get:

REAL-TIME FORM FEEDBACK
Your AI coach corrects your form and posture instantly, to help you avoid building bad habits.

ADAPTIVE COACHING 
Achieve real results by pushing yourself to match the coach's form. Either let the coach adjust as you move or lock in a difficulty.

PERSONAL ACCOUNTABILITY
Complete your daily workout by matching the coach's form on every exercise. On HARD difficulty, only full-range, properly executed reps count.

OFFLINE WORKOUT
Perform your workouts on the go without the internet. 

REVIEW & IMPROVE
See exactly what went wrong after each workout. Replay your movements with a 3D stick figure, frame by frame. No video is stored.

PERSONAL INSIGHTS
Track your progress with form grades, workout history, and streaks. 

CUSTOMIZE YOUR ROUTINE
Program your own routines. Select trained exercises from our library.

WORKOUT PROGRAMS
Stay consistent with challenges, milestones, and rewards.

SEE YOUR BEST REP MOMENT
Before finishing, Firefly shows your strongest rep. Share it instantly.

DAILY CHECK-INS
Get reminders to work out each day and stay consistent.

WORKOUT GOAL TYPES:
Stay Healthy - General full-body movement workouts to keep yourself active
Build Muscle - Strength training focused with mobility exercises for recovery 
Fat/Weight Loss - Balanced mix of workouts meant to protect your muscles as you focus on nutrition
Improve Flexibility - Mix of Yoga & Pilates focused on core strength and mobility stretches
More Energy & Stamina - Full body workout with cardio to increase endurance

FOR COACHES, TRAINERS, PHYSICAL THERAPISTS, INSTRUCTORS
Scale your coaching without adding hours to your schedule. Firefly Classroom turns your programs into an AI coach that delivers consistent 1-on-1 coaching to every client 24/7. To get in contact, visit: https://www.firefly.fitness/contact-us-business

Please exercise safely and progress at your own pace.

Terms of Use: https://www.firefly.fitness/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: https://www.firefly.fitness/privacy
Support: https://www.firefly.fitness/contact-us

quotes.text:
My friends and I made an app that uses your phone's camera to track and improve your form. It'll give you visual and verbal feedback for every rep in real time, ensuring accountability. https://apps.apple.com/us/app/firefly-fitness/id6464440707 (No, we don’t store or view any camera footage as you're working out.)

The challenges and programs are free to try, no sign-ups or subscription required. (We do ask that you sign-up to save your stats). Just swipe down on the paywall. As a heads up, challenges and programs have pre-set strictness, so you’ll need to perform them with proper form.

I created a story-based workout where you start in a room, progress through increasingly difficult levels, and earn badges. I wanted to make the workouts more engaging - Solo Leveling and Lord of the Rings were a hard inspiration! Let me know your thoughts!

Background

We're three friends from Virginia Tech. Starting our journey, we had no idea what to build...until our CTO, who had never worked out before, created a rep-counting app to help himself. That’s when we realized we also forget our rep counts! We looked at other fitness apps and felt they were all the same, just with different designs. You can check out our building process here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=j5CAK40wTwo&t=195s

But, after talking to a lot of people, we discovered three major issues:
